legacy.label: Aquaculture, infrastructure, insurance and processing assistance
legacy.support: Aquaculture, infrastructure, insurance and processing assistance
legacy.benefit: Guideline: infrastructure general 50%, SC/ST/women 60%; fish-farmer inputs 50%; women activities 60%; insurance premium 90%; training 100%, on approved norms. Small RAS/biofloc norm ₹4.5 lakh: individual up to two units at separate sites in stages, group up to four. Solar unit approved actual cost capped ₹15 lakh; hill holding ≥500 sq m or plains ≥1 ha, one unit. Trout input unit ₹90,000 for growers with ≥2 years experience. Matsya Saheli women processing DPR unit norm ₹10 lakh.

legacy.bestFor: Approved fish farmers and eligible groups/women; component-specific area, experience and project criteria.
legacy.status: Programme route verified — current intake unconfirmed
legacy.caution: This is one programme with components. Approved cost norms are not guaranteed cash receipts; annual sanction/current intake unconfirmed. No duplicate central/state insurance assistance.

legacy.name: Uttarakhand Tourism Policy 2023 — investment incentives
legacy.label: capital and operating support
legacy.benefit: Policy capital/reimbursement route for eligible tourism investments; hospitality maximum A/B/C 25/35/50% eligible assets and non-accommodation product/service maximum 100%, but annual cash payout is linked to SGST and permitted additional incentives. Current amendments must be applied.
legacy.eligible: New or qualifying expanded/diversified listed tourism units meeting investment/amenity/NIC conditions, post-notification CAF approval and commercial operations within policy period through 31 March 2030.
legacy.access: Register on Invest Uttarakhand CAF choosing Tourism/Tourism Policy 2023; secure in-principle approval then submit incentive documents through UTDB/TIFC and district tourism committee.
legacy.margin: Applicant contribution and lender or programme conditions apply.
legacy.bestFor: New or qualifying expanded/diversified listed tourism units meeting investment/amenity/NIC conditions, post-notification CAF approval and commercial operations within policy period through 31 March 2030.
legacy.status: Programme route verified — current intake unconfirmed
legacy.caution: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Headline 100% is not an upfront grant. Hospitality lower of 10% maximum or 75% net SGST+permittedadditional incentive annually; product/services lower of 20% maximum or 75% net SGST+additional, subject November 2023 amendments. Same benefit cannot be claimed twice.
